description: The same claim was repeated on three subsequent occasions (12 February, 7 March and 18 May 2026) after the original fact check was published on 9 January 2026. No correction or clarification has been located.
In a written statement on 10 February 2026, Mr Oyelaran said the figure 'should have been around 5 per cent in real per-capita terms' and issued a corrected transcript.
Speaking in the Senate on 6 May 2026, Senator Natarajan restated the figure as '40,000 homes approved for funding, of which around 18,000 are complete'.
PUBLIC RECORD has not located any correction, clarification or restatement of this claim as at 29 September 2026. The claim was repeated unchanged on 12 August 2026.
In a statement on 3 August 2026, Mr Oyelaran said he 'should have said break-ins have risen sharply, not doubled', citing the 23 per cent figure.
On 14 September 2026 Senator Natarajan restated the claim using the revised September release: 'rents in the capitals are growing at their slowest rate since 2020'.
In a statement on 29 September 2026, Mr Oyelaran said his reference to 'record levels' referred to the three-year cumulative total rather than the latest annual figure.
No correction or clarification located as at 30 September 2026.
No correction, clarification or additional evidence located as at 29 September 2026.
